\begin{definition}[Envelope]
\label{def:envelope}
\dcref{ch3:3.1.2-def-1}
\group{Nonlinear First-Order PDE}
Let $u=u(x,a)$ be a complete integral. If the equations
\[
D_a u(x,a)=0
\]
can be solved as $a=\phi(x)$, the function
\[
v(x):=u(x,\phi(x))
\]
is the envelope of the family.
\end{definition}
